places-the-works-of-joze-plecnik-in-ljub.story: From Ljubljana it runs 253 km to Ljubljana; allow about 4 h 22 of riding. It goes by way of Vojsko - Idrijca Water Barrier, City Fortress of Palmanova and back through Vojsko - Idrijca Water Barrier. The highest point is about 900 m. It crosses from Slovenia into Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
